primary_task: Deploy an Azure OpenAI model to the best-capacity region of a Microsoft Foundry project using the Azure CLI.

requirements.name: az (Azure CLI)
requirements.evidence: Prerequisites: "Azure CLI installed and configured"; Key Commands `az account show`, `az cognitiveservices account deployment create`
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI ...); azure-cli is on PyPI, but see the Azure egress and credential items

requirements.name: Azure subscription login (az login) with Cognitive Services permissions
requirements.evidence: "Active Azure subscription with Cognitive Services read/create permissions"; Phase 1 "Verify Auth: Check Azure CLI login and subscription"
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, ...)

requirements.name: Azure Resource Manager / Cognitive Services endpoints (management.azure.com)
requirements.evidence: `az rest --method GET .../modelCapacities`; `az cognitiveservices account deployment create`
requirements.basis: lacks: network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list ... other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA

requirements.name: Microsoft Foundry project resource ID (PROJECT_RESOURCE_ID)
requirements.evidence: "Microsoft Foundry project resource ID (`PROJECT_RESOURCE_ID` env var or provided interactively)"
requirements.basis: The manifest does not say; the user could supply the ID via ask_user, but the project itself lives behind unavailable Azure endpoints

blocking: credential:Azure subscription login (az login) with Cognitive Services permissions
egress:Azure Resource Manager / Cognitive Services endpoints (management.azure.com)
notes: Every phase calls the Azure control plane. No other reading makes the deployment possible; at most the capacity logic could be written as text, which is not the stated deliverable.
